name: io.github.shubhxho/jlcpcb-mcp
title: JLCPCB / LCSC Parts
description: Find and evaluate JLCPCB/LCSC parts for PCB assembly: live search, stock, prices, alternatives.

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional official JLCPCB API app id (enables the official API record in get_component_details; needs all three JLCPCB_* variables)

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional official JLCPCB API access key

environmentVariables.name: JLCPCB_MCP_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Log filter for stderr (error, warn, info, debug)
